description: This file defines API routes for managing calendar events using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, listing, updating, and deleting events, as well as integrating weather forecasts and reminders. The code makes use of dependency injection, schema validation, and recurrence expansion for events.

methods.name: get_weather_client()
methods.description: Provides an instance of WeatherClient for dependency injection.

methods.name: get_notification_client()
methods.description: Provides an instance of NotificationClient for dependency injection.

methods.name: create_event( event: EventCreate, repo: Repository = Depends(get_repository), notification_client: NotificationClient = Depends(get_notification_client), )
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event, assigns it an ID, saves it to the repository, and schedules reminders.

methods.name: get_event( event_id: str, repo: Repository = Depends(get_repository), include_weather: bool = Query(False, description="If true, include weather context"), weather_client: WeatherClient = Depends(get_weather_client) )
methods.description: Retrieves an event by ID; optionally enriches with weather forecast.

methods.name: list_events( user_id: Optional[str] = Query(None), date_from: Optional[datetime] = Query(None), date_to: Optional[datetime] = Query(None), page: int = Query(1, gt=0), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100), include_weather: bool = Query(False, description="If true, include weather context"), repo: Repository = Depends(get_repository), weather_client: WeatherClient = Depends(get_weather_client) )
methods.description: Lists events with optional filters, expands recurrences, paginates, and can include weather data.

methods.name: update_event( event_id: str, patch: EventUpdate, repo: Repository = Depends(get_repository), notification_client: NotificationClient = Depends(get_notification_client), )
methods.description: Updates an existing event's mutable fields and reschedules reminders.

methods.name: delete_event( event_id: str, repo: Repository = Depends(get_repository), )
